description: Add a walkthrough recording the worker sent you, during or after the visit. Listen to it yourself first: if it is clearly a different job or not a walkthrough, tell the worker and ask before you add it. Send what the worker said it is (described_as), your transcript, and recorded_at (when the clip was made, from the file) if you have it. Core keeps no audio: keep the clip on your side and send your clip_ref. The transcript becomes a voice memo note on the visit with any measurements and the worker's notes. Getting any consent the law requires to record is up to the worker and the shop.

clip_ref.description: Your own reference to the clip (file name or id). Core never stores audio.

described_as.description: What the worker said the clip is, in their words.

recorded_at.description: When the clip was recorded, from the file. Default now.

name: visits_addRecording

next_actions.description: Useful next steps to offer, in plain words. op names the op to call, when there is one.
